label: Interval arithmetic
subgoals: Represent each variable by its lower and upper bound
Combine bounds operation by operation, taking corner products for multiplication

label: Joins at merge points
subgoals: Compute the interval on each incoming branch
Take the minimum of the lower bounds and the maximum of the upper bounds
Read off the requested bound of the join

label: Loops, fixpoints and widening
subgoals: Iterate the loop-head interval from the entry value
Intersect with the guard, apply the body and join until stable
Intersect the fixpoint with the negated guard to get the exit interval
